vai-001.voice: Go back out there and teach your family. They need you.
vai-001.situation: Leaving your calling too soon with the excuse of helping others.

vai-002.voice: Why do they get that gift and not me?
vai-002.situation: Jealousy of someone else’s spiritual gifts or insight.

vai-003.voice: I should be ordained, or put in charge.
vai-003.situation: Wanting a sacred role out of vanity, blind to its dangers.
vai-003.note: The bronze censers of Korah’s followers, who seized the priesthood for themselves, were hammered into a warning for Israel.

vai-004.voice: Do the right thing where people can see it.
vai-004.situation: Doing good mainly to be noticed.

vai-005.situation: Mixing talk of your spiritual efforts with a desire for admiration.
vai-005.note: Evagrius pictures vanity yoked to talk of one’s disciplines, like an ox and a donkey pulling one plow.

vai-006.voice: Look how respected you are here.
vai-006.situation: Savoring your standing in other people’s eyes.

vai-007.voice: I can’t leave. What would people think?
vai-007.situation: Staying in an unhealthy place because leaving would hurt your image.

vai-008.voice: Those voices promised me a high position. Maybe they’re right.

vai-009.situation: Rushing to teach before your own soul is healthy.
vai-009.note: Evagrius reads the sparrow’s nest beside God’s altar as staying put until you are grown.

vai-010.voice: Imagine yourself in charge, managing everything.
vai-010.situation: Daydreams of being in charge that scatter your mind.

vai-011.voice: Cut yourself off from them. They’re only leading you astray.
vai-011.situation: Withdrawing from your community out of a sense of superiority.

vai-012.voice: Weigh in on everything. People want your opinion.
vai-012.situation: Talking too much and getting involved in other people’s disputes.

vai-013.voice: Lead them now. You don’t need to wait.
vai-013.situation: Taking charge of others before you are grounded.

vai-014.voice: You haven’t mastered Scripture, so why keep at it?
vai-014.situation: Giving up on Scripture because you can’t master it quickly.

vai-015.voice: You’re young, but you don’t need a mentor.
vai-015.situation: Young and eager to go it alone without guidance.

vai-016.voice: Cosign the loan. They’ll love you for it.
vai-016.situation: Taking on other people’s debts to be liked or admired.

vai-017.voice: Tell them the deep things. They’ll be impressed.
vai-017.situation: Sharing sacred or personal things to impress people who won’t value them.

vai-018.voice: Go out where people can see you. It’ll inspire them.
vai-018.situation: Seeking visibility under the guise of being an example.

vai-019.voice: Bring on the big battles. Imagine the glory of winning.
vai-019.situation: Inviting great trials so you can be admired for surviving them.
vai-019.note: Evagrius learned from John of Thebes that the demon does this out of vainglory.

vai-020.voice: Let them know how disciplined you are.
vai-020.situation: Making sure others hear about your good habits.

vai-021.voice: Speak up now. Stay quiet then. Whatever looks best.
vai-021.situation: Letting vanity decide when you speak and when you stay silent.

vai-022.voice: Surely no one is watching how I serve God.
vai-022.situation: Forgetting that the enemy notices your service and will test your motives.

vai-023.situation: Promises of fame that pose as help.

vai-024.voice: People’s praise matters more to me than knowing Christ.
vai-024.situation: Loving human glory more than the knowledge of Christ.

vai-025.voice: I can’t stop wanting recognition, and I’m already hurting.
vai-025.situation: A persistent longing for glory, on top of anger and sadness.

vai-026.voice: That dream means you’ll be a leader. People will come.
vai-026.situation: Reading dreams as signs of your coming importance.

vai-027.voice: You’re so spiritual you’ll be taken up to heaven.
vai-027.situation: Inflated spiritual experiences that lead to a fall.
vai-027.note: Evagrius says some who believed this were shipwrecked.

vai-028.voice: Your wisdom will make you famous among the powerful.
vai-028.situation: Dreaming of influence with important people.

vai-029.voice: Teach it first. You can practice it later.
vai-029.situation: Wanting to teach what you don’t yet do.

vai-030.voice: Make sure they see you giving.

vai-031.voice: Picture yourself praying. Don’t you look holy?
vai-031.situation: Imagining how you look while you pray.
vai-031.note: Evagrius notes that the mind at prayer has no shape. Picturing yourself praying is vainglory at work.

vai-032.voice: Look a little tired. Let them guess you’re fasting.
vai-032.situation: Letting people know about your fasting or sacrifices.

vai-033.situation: Empty talk that pulls your mind into distraction.

vai-034.voice: Look how spiritually powerful you’ve become!
vai-034.situation: Pride in spiritual victories instead of joy in God’s grace.

vai-035.voice: You have a real gift for healing.
vai-035.situation: Flattering thoughts about your spiritual gifts.

vai-036.voice: Pay your way into the position.
vai-036.situation: Trying to buy influence or a role.

vai-037.voice: Master the world’s learning. Then they’ll respect you.

vai-038.voice: Brag a little about how steady you’ve been.
vai-038.situation: Boasting about your faithfulness and hard work.

vai-039.voice: Convince your relatives you’re on the right path.
vai-039.situation: Needing your family’s approval for your spiritual life.

vai-040.voice: Do something impressive so they’ll choose you.
vai-040.situation: Maneuvering to be chosen for an honored role.

vai-041.voice: You should be teaching others by now.
vai-041.situation: Wanting to teach before you’re grounded in the truth.

vai-042.situation: Asking for spiritual gifts so others will admire you.

vai-043.voice: Look at the glory the world offers.
